message: 結成！　ワルセイダース!!

name: Macaron
message: 「What's your deal, trying to show mercy to your enemy?」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, let's keep things peaceful here, okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Little sister, that was quite a good match. You are definitely getting stronger」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's simply that I was stronger than you from the very beginning」

name: Misa
message: 「There's no need to feel down, Macaron-san」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if you fail once, another chance will surely come around」

name: Misa
message: 「Until the day you defeat Sakura-kun, don't give up on your dream!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seriously, why are they sympathizing with each other...」

name: Misa
message: 「Would you mind telling me where it was sold...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I can teach you how to sew it, you know? It's easy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah, whatever, I don't even care anymore」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm glad. Looks like you two can get along just fine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, let's hurry up and go to the shopping district」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If we take a detour now, our precious Mr. Sea Urchin will get lukewarm!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then let's have a sea urchin party at Synn's place right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeh!? Wait, you mean we can eat it!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Then let's buy ingredients on the way and all make dinner together」

name: Misa
message: 「If Ria-senpai says so, then I agree as well」

name: Macaron
message: 「What? You're actually planning to eat that painful-looking thing?」

name: Ria
message: 「After all, food always tastes better when everyone eats together\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As long as you don't cause any trouble, even the Warusaders are welcome」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, just think of it as returning the favor from the other day」

name: Synn
message: 「Since you treated me to dinner the other day, I'll treat you today, Macaron」

name: Ria
message: 「What's this, what's this, something like that happened?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait a second, you can't even chip in anything, can you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I can at least provide the place and some milk!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Can I bring those guys along too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, shall we throw a fancy little mixer for the Crusaders and the Warusaders!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I keep telling you, we're not the Warusaders~!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee... It sure is lively, isn't it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, everyone, right this way, please」

name: Riesling
message: 「Allow me to see you all there」

name: Macaron
message: 「See us there...? Do you have a carriage or something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, not at all. Your little sister was simply startled since it was her first time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You did a wonderful job as always, Jeeves」

name: Synn
message: 「...Though it surprises me no matter how many times I ride it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about? It's fun!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I hate things I can't move myself!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay. My house barely has any machinery at all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not really something to brag about...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, Big Brother's being attacked by something weird!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, Mako-chan. Watch where you're stepping there, okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「What is this, a super shabby flowerbed?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun grows his own food at home, you know」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, I see you in a whole new light!」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's some impressive self-improvement! You really live up to calling yourself Student Council President」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm gonna go plow up the park too」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun. How long are you gonna drag your feet?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I don't have much to offer, but please, come right in」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm... So this is what it looks like inside...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm looking for tenants, so you're welcome anytime」

name: Macaron
message: 「No way! Living in the same house as you, big brother? You'd totally jump me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, get inside already. You're holding up everyone behind you」

name: Synn
message: 「I try not to keep unnecessary stuff around」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, I'll go ahead and borrow the kitchen」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What should I do until everything is ready」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, shouldn't your little sister help out as well」

name: Macaron
message: 「If we're going to the trouble, I wanna eat something good too~」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's all get along while cooking, okay\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Why don't you guys go play with Sally over there」

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you sure it's okay letting that squirt into the house」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not? Even Lolotte said that getting along is a good thing」

name: Paqy
message: 「I feel like I'm just about to remember something, though...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Starting from here, we have sea urchin kamameshi, sea urchin stew, and seared sea urchin!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sea urchin tempura, whole simmered sea urchin, sea urchin hot sandwiches, and sea urchin pizza!」

name: Macaron
message: 「And for dessert, how about sea urchin daifuku, sea urchin kintoki, and sea urchin glace!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's Mr. Sea Urchin from start to finish!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't pass out with your eyes wide open!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My tummy is so~ full. I'm so~ full of happiness~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you to stop crying, it's creepy」

name: Ria
message: 「The desserts were actually pretty tasty too」

name: Paqy
message: 「If I had to nitpick, I'd have liked to enjoy the raw flavor with some ikizukuri, though」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as it tastes good, anything goes」

name: Macaron
message: 「My master told me raw food isn't good for you, so I ended up cooking it all」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see. Still, Panda-chan, you've got pretty refined tastes」

name: Paqy
message: 「Of course I do. Don't underestimate the Great Sage Paqy-sama!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wha--?! What's so funny, you little punk!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ahaha! B-Because there's no way the Great Sage Paqy is such a tiny runt」

name: Paqy
message: 「What'd you say?! I've got my own circumstances here!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Sure, Panda-chan is cool too, but the real Lord Paqy is way cooler than that」
When Macaron pulls her hood all the way up, a racy little pink bear is complete.

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe, I knew I could count on you, Big Sis Misa. You really get this charm」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch. What would a shorty like you even know, you little pipsqueak」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming from someone who's palm-sized, that doesn't mean much」

name: Ria
message: 「Paa-chan. Don't tease Macaron-chan too much, okay? No-no?」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Panda-chan really listens to whatever Big Sis says, huh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well of course, Ria-chan's boobs are the supreme authority!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see... Boobs are a symbol of authority...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come to think of it, Big Sis Helena was really big too. Yeah, I gotta drink milk」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's milk you want, I've got some」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Thinking ahead about the squirt's future potential--just as expected of Lord Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you see, my pet here is a fan of the Great Sage too」

name: Synn
message: 「So he really is famous in the Demon World, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh, good for you, Paqy. Sounds like you're famous」

name: Paqy
message: 「Damn it. Back in the day, even I used to...」
Macaron would never dream that this panda was actually the real Great Sage.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, whatever the case, the food was delicious.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right?! Have you learned the true extent of my skills now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's definitely keep getting along from now on, okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, wait! It's not like I've yielded to the Crusaders or anything, got it?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, don't say that--let's be all buddy-buddy~」

name: Sally
message: 「The Crusaders and the Warusaders have been best pals for ages now!\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron. Thanks for hanging out with us today」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's fine, whatever. I'm the one who picked a fight with you anyway」

name: Macaron
message: 「I still plan on taking down the Crusaders, that hasn't changed」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now that my tummy's full, I'm starting to get sleepy~...」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady, I have come to escort you home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's gotten pretty late before we knew it, so should we head back too?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, I'm the one who got treated here」

name: Synn
message: 「Feel free to come by again whenever you want」

name: Macaron
message: 「You guys are the ones who should come at me anytime」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll give you some nice, thorough training」

name: Macaron
message: 「It was so-so, pretty much, kind of fun」
I sure hope Re-Crea passes by without anything happening....
